regime_context: The detector shows a broad (8/16 eligible) but undirectional leadership concentration in precious metals: Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners are competing at the top (margin 0.034) with strong durability bars (0.69/0.73) and full breadth (1.0), while most other themes are non-eligible trend-losers. The only validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — worked on this market historically (gate_helps true), so the main sane read is 'stay with the eligible uptrending metals, de-risk the rest', not 'metals will outperform'. Track record n=64 with direction accuracy 0.312 is weak, so conviction caps low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners closes the 0.034-score gap and overtakes Silver & Royalties as the durability-bar leader (breadth staying 1.0 for both and both remaining eligible); the watch retires if Silver & Royalties re-widens the margin above 0.15 or either theme loses eligible status.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are one of two co-leaders with full breadth (1.0) and the highest durability bar (0.73), still trend-eligible under the gate. Given the validated edge is drawdown control via the trend gate, the modest lean is to stay constructive on this eligible, broad, durable leader rather than churn into a lower-ranked theme.
evidence: gate_helps true (trend discipline historically reduced drawdown on this market)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners share the XGD.TO proxy with Silver & Royalties and are nearly indistinguishable (score margin 0.034), so this is not an independent signal — and rank-IC is ~0, so leadership does not imply forward return.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 50-day average and the theme loses eligible status before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers rank 4 and remain eligible, but crowding_z 1.29 marks the theme as crowded. Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so the accountable lean is to avoid adding/overweighting this theme while it stays crowded, not to underweight or short it.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership can persist through crowding in a supply-constrained tape; crowding has no basket-level forward edge and no mean-reversion timing, so 'avoid' may simply miss continued upside.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO's crowding_z drops below 1.0 while it stays eligible and its score holds above rank 4 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the nominal leader with the highest score (2.127), full breadth (1.0), and a strong durability bar (0.69), while the gate is historically helpful here. Same logic as Gold Miners: a trend-following, vol-aware stance keeps the eligible broad leader as a constructive lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The margin over Gold Miners is only 0.034 — statistically nothing — and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so any 'leadership' here is an attention lens, not alpha.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses eligible status or Silver & Royalties' breadth falls below 0.7 while Gold Miners hold breadth near 1.0 before the check-by date
